description: Create an Airflow DAG for retail_chain that produces operational reports with different content depending on the day. The DAG should use BranchDayOfWeekOperator and @task.branch such that: every day runs 'daily_sales_report'; Mondays additionally run 'weekly_rollup'; the first business day of the month additionally runs 'monthly_close_report'. The branch callable must be able to return multiple task ids. All reports feed a final 'distribute_reports' task that emails whichever reports were produced.
edge_cases: Weekday must be evaluated against the logical date (use_task_logical_date=True), not the wall-clock date
First business day of the month: if the 1st is a Saturday, the monthly report runs on Monday the 3rd, together with the weekly rollup
weekly_rollup covers the previous Monday-Sunday, not the trailing 7 days including today
distribute_reports must attach only the reports whose tasks succeeded, determined from task states or XCom, not by checking for file existence from earlier runs
common_failure_modes: FM6: Branch callable returns a single task id, so the weekly and monthly reports can never run on the same day
FM2: Weekly rollup window computed as ds-7..ds includes the current partial day and misses the previous Monday
FM6: BranchDayOfWeekOperator without use_task_logical_date picks the wrong branch on reruns
